voice.tone: Result-driven and contrarian. Lead with what sets you apart (what competitors get wrong), back it with concrete numbers, no oversell. Direct without being cold; confident without superlatives.
voice.rhythm: Mix of punchy headlines and flowing explanatory prose. Short paragraphs. Frequent lists and bullet points. Designed to scan. Occasional single-sentence paragraph for emphasis.
voice.person: We/our for the company. Your/you for the customer. Frame value from the customer's perspective. Personify the AI product (Aura) with she/her pronouns and agency ("Aura handles," "Aura answers").
exemplars: Most AI customer support tools were built to reply, not resolve. Customerly's AI agent, Aura, takes action, handles tickets end to end, and runs in one platform with your helpdesk, live chat and help center.
5 trips sold in 7 days. Zero humans involved.

Your data is not just an asset, it's a responsibility. Security is an integral part of how we build Customerly: encrypted everywhere, hosted in the EU, monitored around the clock, and designed so you can focus on your customers while we protect their data.

Welcome to Customerly! Whether you're a business looking to enhance customer support or a startup aiming to streamline communication, this guide will help you get up and running with Customerly in no time.

SaaS teams use Customerly's AI agent, Aura, as the first responder on every conversation. It resolves common questions instantly using the knowledge base and product data, qualifies inbound leads, and escalates only the complex cases to a human with full context.
